title: C24: after a long flush, does the open-interest path call the next move?

what.name: Flush
what.value_plain: 5m bar with price -0.25% or worse and Bybit OI -0.2% or worse
what.label: OURS

what.name: Chop
what.value_plain: price moves under 0.8% over the next 40 min
what.label: OURS

what.name: Groups
what.value_plain: OI over those 40 min: rebuilds >= +0.2%, flat, keeps falling <= -0.2%
what.label: OURS

how: oi_after_flush.py; next 1h and 4h move vs every-30-min base. No trade, no fees.

verdict.label: NO direction: all groups near a coin flip (4h up 53/56/55% vs 52% base).

why: Still-falling OI makes a >1% move in 4h more likely (14% vs 6%), but not which way.
OI tells who is trapped when a level breaks, not where price goes; this feeds the dashboard 'What the money is doing' tile.
